content.text: Two candidates, two classifications. The token in src/Worker/appsettings.Production.json is read at runtime by the provider client and ships in the deployed configuration, so it is a live credential: veto item live-credential-in-diff, verdict BLOCK. The value in tests/Fixtures/tokens.json is the vendor's published example key, used only under test and read by nothing outside the test project, so it is a fixture and stays in the triage notes. I am citing path and line only — the value never appears in my report, I have not called the provider to verify it, and the escalation says rotate: revoke first, then issue, then update the store, then redeploy. Removing the line does not un-leak it.
